title: Cloud Network Security Engineer
jobDescription: Job Description – Cloud Network Security Engineer Experience: 3+ yrs Job Location: Pune (Viman Nagar) Key Responsibilities:- 1. Expertise in AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI networking including VPC/VNet design, routing, subnets, gateways, NAT, load balancers, VPN, and interconnectivity. 2. Deep hands-on experience in network security across multi-cloud environments. 3. Strong proficiency in Firewalls – Palo Alto (Panorama) and Fortinet FortiGate. 4. Working experience with Azure Native Firewall & Azure NGFW deployments and policy management. 5. End-to-end design and implementation of Multi-ISP and cloud connectivity, including: AWS Direct Connect Azure ExpressRoute GCP Interconnect OCI FastConnect 6. Strong understanding of Hub & Spoke network architecture and cloud transit models. 7. Expertise in routing protocols – BGP, OSPF, static routing, VRF, IPsec tunnels. 8. Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) for network and security deployment. 9. Proficiency in scripting languages – Python, Bash, PowerShell (any). 10. title: L3 Azure Cloud / Azure Solution Architect
jobDescription: Job Title: L3 Azure Cloud / Azure Solution Architect Role Summary: We are looking for an experienced L3 Azure Cloud / Azure Solution Architect to design, validate, and drive the implementation of enterprise-grade Azure cloud solutions. The candidate should have strong expertise in Azure architecture, security, governance, and cloud transformation, with the ability to translate high-level solution designs into detailed implementation plans. Key Responsibilities: • Design and implement Azure cloud solutions using both SaaS (Shared and Dedicated) and PaaS service models. • Develop secure, scalable, and highly available cloud architectures aligned with Azure best practices. • Apply a Zero Trust security approach across identity, networking, workload, and data protection. • Ensure compliance with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements. • Review and validate the proposed cloud architecture and recommend improvements where required. • Convert the approved solution architecture into a detailed Statement of Work (SoW), including implementation activities, milestones, dependencies, timelines, and deliverables. • Create an executable implementation roadmap and provide technical guidance to the implementation team. • Support technical governance, architecture reviews, risk assessment, and issue resolution during implementation. • Collaborate with stakeholders, infrastructure teams, application teams, and security teams to ensure successful project delivery. Required Skills & Experience: • Strong hands-on experience as an Azure Solution Architect or Senior Azure Cloud Architect. • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure services, including networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and governance. • Experience designing solutions leveraging Azure SaaS, PaaS, and hybrid cloud services. • Strong knowledge of Azure security, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure Policy, Microsoft Sentinel, and Zero Trust architecture. • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates) is preferred. • Experience preparing detailed Statements of Work (SoW), implementation plans, and technical documentation. • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer (GCP & Kubernetes)
jobDescription:
Experience:

5+ years overall in Cloud Operations, including:

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Kubernetes administration

 

Certifications:

✅ GCP Certified Professional – Mandatory

 

Work Hours:

  • 24x7 support coverage
  • Rotational shifts (including night and weekend shifts)

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and monitor GCP infrastructure resources, ensuring optimal performance, availability, and security.
  • Administer Kubernetes clusters: deployment, scaling, upgrades, patching, and troubleshooting.
  • Implement and maintain automation for provisioning, scaling, and monitoring using tools like Terraform, Helm, or similar.
  • Respond to incidents, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution within SLAs.
  • Configure logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions across GCP and Kubernetes environments.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and integrate Kubernetes deployments with DevOps processes.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of processes, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Work collaboratively with Development, Security, and Architecture teams to ensure compliance and best practices.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and respond promptly to critical alerts.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • GCP Certified Professional (Cloud Architect, Cloud Engineer, or equivalent).
  • Strong working knowledge of GCP services (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, Cloud Monitoring, etc.).
  • Solid experience in Kubernetes cluster administration (setup, scaling, upgrades, security hardening).
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Deployment Manager).
  • Knowledge of containerization concepts and tools (Docker).
  • Experience in monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Stackdriver).
  • Familiarity with incident management and ITIL processes.
  • Ability to work in 24x7 operations with rotating shifts.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience supporting multi-cloud environments.
  • Scripting skills (Python, Bash, Go).
  • Exposure to other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).
  • Familiarity with security controls and compliance frameworks.

title: L2 CDN & Edge Security Engineer
jobDescription: L2 CDN & Edge Security Engineer - 3-6 yrs – Pune Job Title L2 CDN & Edge Security Engineer Job Summary We are looking for a skilled and proactive L2 CDN & Edge Security Engineer to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise CDN and edge security platforms including Akamai Technologies and Cloudflare environments. The engineer will be responsible for supporting global web applications, CDN delivery optimization, WAF policy management, DNS operations, SSL certificate management, DDoS mitigation support, and troubleshooting production incidents across multi-cloud environments. The ideal candidate should have strong networking fundamentals, hands-on CDN troubleshooting experience, and knowledge of web security technologies. Key Responsibilities CDN Operations & Support • Manage and support CDN platforms including Akamai and Cloudflare. • Configure and maintain CDN properties, cache policies, and routing rules. • Perform cache purging/invalidation activities. • Configure and troubleshoot origin connectivity issues. • Support global traffic acceleration and content optimization. Incident Management & Troubleshooting • Handle L2 production incidents and escalations from L1 teams. • Troubleshoot HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, SSL/TLS, and CDN-related issues. • Investigate website latency, downtime, and cache performance issues. • Analyze CDN logs, traffic patterns, and edge behavior. • Coordinate with application, cloud, network, and security teams for issue resolution. Security & WAF Operations • Manage WAF rules, rate limiting, bot protection, and geo-blocking policies. • Investigate DDoS attacks and support mitigation activities. • Tune security policies to reduce false positives. • Monitor and respond to security alerts and suspicious traffic activity. • Support OWASP Top 10 protection implementation. DNS & SSL Management • Configure and manage DNS records including A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, and MX records. • Manage SSL certificate onboarding, renewal, and troubleshooting. • Validate TLS configurations and certificate chains. • Support DNS failover and load balancing configurations. Monitoring & Performance Optimization • Monitor CDN health, edge performance, and traffic analytics. • Optimize cache hit ratios and origin offload. • Analyze latency, bandwidth usage, and web performance metrics. • Work with monitoring tools like Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, and Kibana. Change Management • Implement CDN and security configuration changes during maintenance windows. • Validate post-change functionality and rollback if required. • Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and RCA reports. Automation & Scripting • Support automation activities using APIs, CLI tools, and scripting. • Work with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines where applicable. • Assist in operational improvements and process automation. Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills • Strong understanding of: o CDN technologies o HTTP/HTTPS protocols o DNS architecture o SSL/TLS o TCP/IP networking o Reverse proxy concepts o Load balancing • Hands-on experience with: o Akamai CDN o Cloudflare CDN & WAF o WAF policy management o DDoS mitigation o CDN troubleshooting • Knowledge of: o Linux administration o Shell/Python scripting basics o REST APIs o Monitoring tools o Log analysis Preferred Skills • Experience with: o Multi-cloud environments o Amazon Web Services o Google Cloud o Microsoft Azure o Terraform o CI/CD pipelines o DevSecOps concepts • Knowledge of: o OWASP Top 10 o Zero Trust Security o API Security o Bot Management o SIEM tools Experience Required • 3–6 years of experience in: o CDN Operations o Network Operations o Cloud Networking o Edge Security o Web Application Security Educational Qualification • Bachelor’s degree in: o Computer Science o Information Technology o Electronics & Communication o Related technical field Certifications (Preferred) • Akamai Certifications • Cloudflare Certifications • CCNA / Network+ • Security+ • Cloud certifications from AWS, Azure, or GCP Tools & Technologies  Category Tools/Platforms CDN Akamai, Cloudflare Monitoring Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, Kibana Networking DNS, TCP/IP, Load Balancers Security WAF, DDoS, Bot Protection OS Linux Automation Python, Bash, APIs Cloud AWS, Azure, GCP Soft Skills • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills • Good communication and stakeholder management • Ability to work in 24x7 operational environments • Team collaboration and incident coordination • Documentation and reporting skills Job Location • Pune Employment Type • Full-Time

title: Network Security Compliance Check & Remediation Engineer
jobDescription: Job Description – Network Security Compliance Check & Remediation Engineer Position Title Network Security Compliance Check & Remediation Engineer Experience 3–8 Years (L2/L3 depending on experience) Location India (Hybrid/Onsite) Department Network Security & Compliance Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Network Security Compliance Check & Remediation Engineer responsible for ensuring that network and security infrastructure complies with internal security standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. The candidate will perform security compliance assessments, identify gaps, drive remediation activities, and work closely with network, cloud, security, and operations teams to maintain a secure and compliant environment. The role requires strong expertise in network security technologies, firewall management, security hardening, vulnerability management, access governance, change management, and compliance auditing. Key Responsibilities Firewall & Security Policy Compliance • Conduct periodic firewall rule reviews and security policy audits. • Identify and remediate: o Zero-hit firewall rules o Redundant or duplicate rules o Expired temporary access rules o Overly permissive access policies • Review and optimize Disaster Recovery (DR) firewall configurations. • Ensure firewall policies align with security and regulatory standards. Network Security Compliance Reviews • Perform compliance assessments against security baselines and organizational standards. • Validate network segmentation and access controls. • Review and maintain network security architecture documentation. Network Documentation & Inventory Management • Create and maintain network diagrams and security architecture documentation. • Maintain accurate inventory of: o Firewalls o Routers o Switches o Load Balancers o Security Appliances o Cloud Network Components Access Management & Governance • Perform periodic user access reviews. • Validate privileged account access. • Ensure least-privilege access principles are followed. • Coordinate access certification and recertification activities. Security Hardening • Review and implement network device hardening standards. • Conduct periodic hardening audits for: o Firewalls o Routers o Switches o VPN Devices o Cloud Network Security Components • Track and manage recurring hardening activities. Change & Incident Management • Review and implement network security change requests. • Participate in CAB (Change Advisory Board) activities. • Handle emergency changes and ensure proper documentation. • Perform post-change validation and risk assessment. Risk Assessment & Remediation • Conduct risk assessments for insecure services and ports. • Identify security gaps and recommend remediation measures. • Track remediation activities until closure. • Prepare risk treatment plans and compliance reports. Patch & Vulnerability Management • Ensure network and security devices are maintained at N-1 software versions. • Coordinate firmware and software upgrades. • Track and remediate vulnerabilities identified through: o Vulnerability Assessments o Security Scans o Penetration Testing VAPT Management • Coordinate Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT). • Analyze findings and prioritize remediation. • Validate closure of vulnerabilities. • Prepare management reports and compliance evidence. Asset Lifecycle Management • Track AMC contracts and warranty status. • Monitor: o Hardware End of Life (EOL) o Software End of Life (EOL) o End of Support (EOS) • Drive technology refresh and remediation planning.
